name: Incunabulum Keeper
tactics: An incunabulum keeper counts on its white hand authority aura and feed on the vulnerable power to aid its undead allies, creating a defensive cordon while it focuses sword of keeping attacks on lightly armored foes.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: White Hand Authority
traits.details: one undead ally within the aura at the start of the incunabulum keeper’s turn can make a melee basic attack as a free action.

auras.name: White Hand Authority
auras.details: one undead ally within the aura at the start of the incunabulum keeper’s turn can make a melee basic attack as a free action.

hit.description: damage plus 1d8 psychic damage, and the target is immobilized until the end of the keeper’s next turn

attacks.name: Hit
attacks.targets: targets one allied undead creature adjacent to an immobilized enemy

effect.description: the next time the target makes a check to recharge a power, it makes an extra check as a free action.
Each ally within 5 squares of the keeper makes a basic attack against an immobilized enemy as a free action, provided the ally can both see and hear the keeper.

powers.name: Martial Secret
powers.trigger: when the incunabulum keeper is hit by a melee attack or a close attack

effect.description: The triggering attacker rerolls the attack roll with a -2 penalty.
